title: Make current dissent storage immutable
objective: Ensure dissent accepted into the live aggregate cannot be removed, replaced, or rewritten while preserving attributable historical versions.
forbidden_actions: read or reuse credentials from chat
commit directly to a protected baseline
delete or rewrite immutable historical records
change a formal Foundry Program stage
authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or production action

acceptance_criteria.description: Attempted removal or rewrite of accepted dissent fails closed.
Current aggregate state is reconciled from immutable attributable dissent records.
A regression covers the reviewed live-aggregate mutation path.

protected_actions: delete or rewrite immutable historical records
approve or merge the pull request
configure repository visibility or branch protection
